summary: Assist RMRG with rescue of two climbers on Little Pawnee Peak (2020-80)
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
notes: ART mission 2020-80. Subject outcomes not stated. ME 'Two hikers stranded overnight near Little Pawnee Peak' (run 471): night of Aug 9 + morning Aug 10, two hikers hoisted by Colorado Army National Guard from the mountainside; 17.5-hr rescue, 27 personnel on night of Aug 9 and 27 on morning of Aug 10; BCSO case 20-3511 - same incident as Alpine 2020-80.
